## About
Choosing the private tour with GoldenTicketLA gives you the control of your tours, as you decide what to see, when to take the tour and how long to stay. Choose a pace that suits you! Our services allow you to visit the most famous sights and hidden gems that are not in the travel guides. So you get to see the real side of LA! It is perfect for groups up to 7 people who want something really special for themselves while visiting the City of Angeles!

Free Pick up in Beverly Hills

## What to Bring
Please bring a camera!
